recent_transactions.rationale: BUY: Astera Labs sourced from the 10/14 theme screen (AI data-center interconnect/connectivity silicon -- PCIe/CXL retimers and Scorpio fabric switches linking GPUs/CPUs inside AI server racks). Quant score driven by 104.5% revenue growth, 186.2% earnings growth, forward P/E 45.3 -- the top-ranked non-disqualified, non-opportunity-tier candidate on today's full watchlist screen (market cap ~$50.3B). Dedicated research check found no October-specific news, good or bad: the known customer-concentration risk flagged at the 10/14 add (top 4 customers ~82% of Q2 revenue per the Q2 10-Q) remains disclosed and stable, not worsening, and the stock's recent weakness reads as the broader sector-wide chip selloff (hitting CRDO/peers too) rather than a company-specific issue. Fundamentals intact: Q2'26 revenue $392M (>2x YoY, beat), Q3 guided to $540-560M (~40% QoQ). Passed on five higher-scoring candidates on this screen, each disqualified for a specific, dated reason: ASTS (still no news addressing the 10/13 Piper Sandler SpaceX-competitive-threat downgrade that triggered our 10/16 exit -- re-buy restriction stands), RCAT (CRO retaliation lawsuit from the 7/21 for-cause termination remains unresolved, no October update), SERV (Uber Eats non-renewal now confirmed executed -- Grubhub/DoorDash diversification is real but FY26 guidance cut to $9-10M stands, stock down ~45% over the past year), ZENA (a fresh October 2026 Form 424B5 offering at $1.35/share confirms, rather than resolves, the dilution concern flagged at the 10/14 pass), and IONQ (no news since 10/14 addressing the Elisity-deal/dilutive-raise strategic-drift concern behind our 10/14 exit; the ~35.8M new shares for Elisity, ~9% of shares out, confirm the dilution is material). Also passed on NVDA, which clears on fundamentals (105.9% revenue growth, 127.8% earnings growth, forward P/E 13.9, no negative catalyst found) but is the familiar mega-cap -- per the mandate against defaulting to blue chips over a smaller name the screen ranked higher without a specific reason, preferring ALAB here since nothing in the research disqualifies it. Not opportunity-tier; sized to the available cash above the 2% buffer floor ($54.16), the binding constraint today (ample remaining room in both the Technology sector cap and the 15% position cap).

Fundamentals data (market cap, revenue/earnings growth) is unavailable this run -- yfinance's quoteSummary endpoint returned 401 Unauthorized/Invalid Crumb for all 91 tracked tickers today, a full fundamentals-API outage, not specific to this decision.
